Class TransactionManagementController

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.controller.TransactionManagementController
public class TransactionManagementController extends Object
Controller for managing transaction viewing, reporting, and sales analytics. Provides GUI event-driven methods for transaction-related operations including viewing transactions by various criteria and calculating sales totals.
